rules.name: 01-Inbound Fedex Replacements
rules.description: Oracle subscribes to an AWS queue that informs us of fedex packages that need to be replace.  We create an incident for those packages, and use CUSTOM_CFG_WIZMO_DAMAGED_INCIDENT_CREATE_MAPPING to set initial values.  This rule will look for those initial values and transition the incident to the 02 state.  It will sit in a closed state and only reopen by a rule in the 02 state if the replacement process determines manual intervention is needed.  This is determined by a cronrunner task periodically checking on the status.
